request: Run concurrency-control on this: plans are JSON documents in a document store. The save endpoint reads the document, applies the user's edits, and replaces it. Two planners editing one plan lose each other's changes. The client retries a save when it times out. A nightly job recomputes plan totals on the same documents, and after a scale-out two instances of it ran at once. What write model does each writer need?

expect.criterion: concurrency-control #1: a change that writes a shared record gets a write-model record per writer
concurrency-control #1: a change that writes a shared record gets a write-model record per writer
concurrency-control #2: independent editors of one record get a version check the store enforces
concurrency-control #3: a job one process must own gets a lease with a fencing token
concurrency-control #4: a retried request carries an idempotency key
concurrency-control #5: a read-modify-replace save with no condition is UNGUARDED and blocks the change
summary-led-report #2: the decision opens with the four blocks in order
